answer: Cap withdrawals by age. A new identity can move at most 1,000 POA of earnings off-ledger per epoch, and the cap doubles every 8 epochs it stays clean, a slow spiral up to full liquidity after about 80 epochs. A farm that spins up 200 fresh heads to dump rewards can exit only 200,000 POA per epoch while audits keep running, so any slash lands on value still on-chain. Seen through that prism, a sybil's payout sits locked in shale: present, but too slow to extract before it is caught.
